title: 第一卷 第64章 洗鸳鸯浴！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓

第(1/3)页

林骁快步走进内堂，只见顾怀玉正伏在案边，哭得肩膀一耸一耸的。

他把包袱和酒坛放在地上，走到她身边，轻声道：“大人，您没事吧？”

顾怀玉闻声抬起头。

她眼眶通红，脸上还挂着泪珠，最显眼的是额头，肿起了一个大包，透着血丝，在白皙的皮肤上显得格外刺眼。

林骁蹲下身，眉头紧锁：“这伤是怎么弄的？”

顾怀玉用袖子擦了擦眼泪，哽咽道：“村民们不理解为何粮食涨价，我又不能明说是为了引外地粮商进来……只能安抚，方才混乱中，有个村民扔石头，正好砸中了。”

林骁一听，猛地一拍桌子，怒道：“太不像话了，这帮刁民！我这就去找他们算账！”

他说着就要往外冲。

顾怀玉急忙伸手拽住他的胳膊：“别去了！林兄，他们也是有苦衷的，荒年饥荒，粮食又涨价，家家都要饿死了，他们也是急疯了……”

林骁停下脚步，看着她那副梨花带雨却还替百姓着想的样子，心里莫名一软。

他轻叹一声，语气缓和下来：“大人，看你受委屈，我心里难受。”

这句话说得真诚。

顾怀玉愣了一下，心中的委屈和感动交织，眼泪又忍不住掉了下来。

她擦了擦眼角，低声道：“不碍事，等外地粮商到了，粮食多了，自然就好了。”

“大人真是宅心仁厚。”林骁看着她，忽然道，“我不由地想为您题几个字。”

“你还会题字？”顾怀玉有些惊讶。

“略懂，略懂。”林骁笑了笑，唤来衙役取来卷轴和笔墨。

他铺开宣纸，提笔饱蘸浓墨，略一沉思，便洋洋洒洒写下了十四个大字。

先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。

顾怀玉盯着那十四个字，眼睛骤然一亮。

这短短两句话，像针一样扎进她心里，把她积压的所有委屈、抱负都写了出来。

她激动得嘴唇微颤，立刻命人将这卷轴挂在大堂两侧最显眼的地方。

“林兄真是好文采，比我父亲都厉害。”她看着林骁，眼神里满是欣赏。

林骁笑了笑：“大人过奖。”

“只是，不知外面的村民该如何安抚呢？”

“我有办法。”林骁带着她走出内堂，来到衙门口。

此时，门外还围着不少情绪激动的村民，有人甚至嚷嚷着：“粮食不降价，我就一头撞死在这柱子上！”

林骁见状，大步上前，厉声喝道：“都给我肃静！”

这一嗓子，中气十足，震得在场的人都安静下来。

“吵什么吵！”林骁指着台下，“粮食涨价，正是大人的英明决策，你们这群蠢货，懂什么深意！”

一个壮汉不服气地喊道：“我是不懂，但我知道，再这么涨下去，我一家老小就要饿死了！”

“急什么急！”林骁冷笑一声，抛出重磅消息，“大人已经决定了，为了抵御外敌蛮族入侵，即日起，重修桃园县城墙，凡是愿意出工的，每人每日三十文工钱，现在开始报名！”

台下一片哗然。

“每日三十文？一月就近一两银子？”

“真的假的？官府会这么好心？”

“这比种地强多了！”

顾怀玉也震惊地看着林骁。

她从未想过修城墙的事。

林骁凑到她耳边，低声道：“大人，这叫以工代赈，让他们用劳力换钱，既能安抚民心，又能修好城墙。”

顾怀玉恍然大悟，立刻挺直腰板，朗声道：“没错，桃园县城墙年久失修，若是蛮人来犯，必当一击即溃，即日起，招募民夫，修筑城墙！”

“我去！”

“我也去！”

“算我一个！”

台下的抱怨声瞬间变成了报名声。

Page (1/3)

Lin Xiao quickly walked into the inner hall and saw Gu Huaiyu leaning beside the desk, crying so hard that his shoulders were shrugging.

He put the baggage and the wine jar on the ground, walked to her side, and said softly: "Sir, are you okay?"

Gu Huaiyu raised his head when he heard the sound.

Her eyes were red, and there were tears on her face. The most conspicuous thing was her forehead, which had a big swelling with bloodshot eyes, which looked particularly dazzling on her fair skin.

Lin Xiao squatted down and frowned: "How did you get this injury?"

Gu Huaiyu wiped her tears with her sleeves and choked up: "The villagers don't understand why the price of food has increased. I can't clearly say it is to attract grain merchants from other places... I can only comfort them. In the chaos just now, a villager threw a stone and it hit it."

When Lin Xiao heard this, he slammed the table and said angrily: "It's so outrageous, these gangsters! I'm going to settle the score with them right now!"

He said as he rushed out.

Gu Huaiyu hurriedly reached out and grabbed his arm: "Don't go! Brother Lin, they also have their own reasons. In the famine years, the price of food has increased, and every family is starving to death. They are also crazy..."

Lin Xiao stopped and felt inexplicably weak when he looked at her expression of caring about the people even though the flowers were blooming.

He sighed softly and softened his tone: "Sir, seeing you being wronged makes me feel uncomfortable."

This is said sincerely.

Gu Huaiyu was stunned for a moment, feeling aggrieved and moved in his heart, and couldn't help but shed tears.

She wiped the corners of her eyes and whispered: "It doesn't matter. Once the grain merchants from other places arrive and there is more grain, it will be fine."

"My lord is really kind-hearted." Lin Xiao looked at her and suddenly said, "I can't help but want to write a few words for you."

"You can also write inscriptions?" Gu Huaiyu was a little surprised.

"I understand a little, I understand a little." Lin Xiao smiled and called the yamen servant to get the scroll and pen and ink.

He spread out the rice paper, dipped his pen in thick ink, pondered for a moment, and then wrote fourteen big characters eloquently.

Worry when the world is worried first, and rejoice when the world is happy later.

Gu Huaiyu stared at the fourteen words, and his eyes suddenly lit up.

These two short sentences pierced her heart like a needle, writing out all the grievances and ambitions she had accumulated.

Her lips trembled with excitement, and she immediately ordered someone to hang the scroll in the most conspicuous place on both sides of the hall.

"Brother Lin is really talented in literature, even better than my father." She looked at Lin Xiao with admiration in her eyes.

Lin Xiao smiled: "Thank you, sir."

"It's just that I don't know how to appease the villagers outside?"

"I have a way." Lin Xiao led her out of the inner hall and to the Yamen Gate.

At this time, there were many excited villagers surrounding the door. Some even shouted: "If the price of food is not reduced, I will hit my head on this pillar and die!"

Seeing this, Lin Xiao strode forward and shouted sternly: "Everyone, be quiet!"

This voice was so powerful that everyone present fell silent.

"Why are you making such a fuss!" Lin Xiao pointed to the audience, "The increase in food prices is a wise decision made by adults. What do you idiots know?"

A strong man shouted unconvinced: "I don't understand, but I know that if the price continues to rise like this, my whole family will starve to death!"

"What's the rush!" Lin Xiao sneered and dropped the bombshell news, "Your Excellency has decided that in order to resist the barbarian invasion from foreign enemies, Taoyuan County's city wall will be rebuilt from now on. Anyone who is willing to work will be paid thirty cents per person per day. Sign up now!"

The audience was in an uproar.

"Thirty cents a day? Nearly one tael a month?"

"Really? Would the government be so kind?"

"This is much better than farming!"

Gu Huaiyu also looked at Lin Xiao in shock.

She never thought about building the city wall.

Lin Xiao leaned close to her ear and whispered: "Sir, this is called work-for-relief. Let them exchange labor for money, which can not only appease the people, but also repair the city wall."

Gu Huaiyu suddenly realized it, and immediately straightened his back and said loudly: "Yes, the Taoyuan County city wall has been in disrepair for a long time. If the barbarians invade, they will be defeated in one blow. From now on, we will recruit civilians to build the city wall!"

"I'll go!"

"I'll go too!"

"Count me in!"

The complaints in the audience instantly turned into calls for registration.
